categories.main_business_segments: Tohoku Electric Power operates primarily in two business segments: 'Power Generation & Sales,' which includes thermal, nuclear, and renewable energy generation, electricity retail, and related solutions; and 'Transmission & Distribution,' which provides neutral and fair electricity network services. The company also engages in ancillary businesses such as engineering, IT, and real estate through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in thermal, nuclear, hydro, and renewable energy generation, including biomass and wind power. It is actively developing decarbonization technologies such as hydrogen and ammonia co-firing, floating offshore wind, and advanced forecasting for renewables. Digital transformation (DX), smart metering, and automated infrastructure monitoring (e.g., drone-based inspections) are also key production and operational methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tohoku Electric Power serves a broad customer base, including residential, commercial, and industrial users, primarily in the Tohoku region and Niigata Prefecture. It also supplies electricity to other utilities and participates in wholesale electricity markets. The company is expanding solution services for corporate clients, including corporate PPAs and energy management solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core service area covers the six prefectures of Tohoku and Niigata Prefecture in Japan, with some business activities extending to the Tokyo metropolitan area and overseas investments through subsidiaries. Over 90% of its assets and sales are domestic, with a strong regional focus.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tohoku Electric Power operates across the entire electricity supply chain, from upstream (power generation, including fuel procurement and renewable development) to midstream (transmission and distribution networks) and downstream (retail sales and customer solutions). It also provides engineering and consulting services related to energy infrastructure.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include achieving carbon neutrality by 2050, expanding renewable energy, decarbonizing thermal power, and promoting electrification. The company is investing in digital transformation (DX), resilience against climate and disaster risks, and human capital development. R&D focuses on decarbonization technologies, smart grid solutions, and new business models leveraging digital and AI technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through electricity sales to retail and wholesale customers, network usage fees, and solution services. Additional income comes from engineering, IT, and real estate services provided by subsidiaries. The company also receives government subsidies for energy price relief and participates in financial and trading activities related to energy markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tohoku Electric Power is one of Japan’s major regional electric utilities, competing with other regional power companies (e.g., Tokyo Electric Power, Hokkaido Electric Power) and new entrants in the liberalized electricity market. It maintains a strong position in its core region but faces increasing competition in both retail and wholesale markets due to deregulation and decarbonization trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated revenue was approximately 2.64 trillion yen, with operating profit of 280.3 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 182.8 billion yen. The company has recovered profitability after previous losses, with a self-financing ratio of 18.3%. It is targeting stable growth, financial recovery, and a capital efficiency (ROIC) of 3.5% or higher by 2030.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tohoku Electric Power emphasizes reliable, safe, and affordable electricity supply, regional engagement, and tailored solutions for customer needs. Its differentiation lies in a strong commitment to carbon neutrality, integration of renewables, advanced digital services, and a deep-rooted presence in the Tohoku region. The company positions itself as a trusted partner for regional development and sustainable energy solutions.
